overview: QuRL accelerates reinforcement learning training for reasoning LLMs by deploying a quantized actor for rollout while maintaining full-precision parameters for gradient updates, introducing Adaptive Clipping Range (ACR) to stabilize training and Update-Aware Quantization (UAQ) with invariant scaling to bridge the magnitude mismatch between weight updates and quantization noise.

modules.name: Quantization Engine
modules.description: Core quantization operations supporting INT8 and FP8 formats, including channel-wise weight quantization, token-wise activation quantization, and scaling factor computation based on group-wise maximum absolute values.

modules.name: Invariant Scaling (UAQ)
modules.description: Implements Update-Aware Quantization by applying a scale factor to weight columns and corresponding activation rows, reducing quantization error while amplifying weight update magnitude, with the scaling absorbed into preceding LayerNorm layers.

modules.name: Decoupled PPO Objective
modules.description: Implements the decoupled PPO formulation that separates the behavior policy (quantized old actor for sampling) from the proximal policy (full-precision old actor for clipping), computing the importance sampling ratio between the current full-precision actor and the proximal policy.

modules.name: Adaptive Clipping Range (ACR)
modules.description: Dynamically adjusts the PPO clipping range based on the ratio between the behavior and proximal policies; when the behavior policy is truncated, the upper clipping bound is enlarged by the reciprocal of the truncation ratio to allow more positive-advantage tokens to pass.

modules.name: Truncated Importance Sampling (TIS)
modules.description: Implements truncated importance sampling that bounds the proximal-to-behavior policy ratio by a constant, preventing gradient explosion from extremely small behavior policy probabilities and reducing computational overhead by directly accessing inference engine probabilities.

modules.name: GRPO Algorithm Core
modules.description: Implements the Group Relative Policy Optimization algorithm including group-based advantage estimation using relative rewards, the PPO-style clipped surrogate objective with KL regularization against a reference model, and the k3 KL estimator.

modules.name: DAPO Algorithm Core
modules.description: Implements the Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization with separate high and low clipping ranges, dynamic sampling of rollout responses per query, and no KL divergence penalty between actor and reference models.

modules.name: PPO Algorithm Core
modules.description: Implements the standard Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm with the clipped surrogate objective, generalized advantage estimation, and KL penalty or constraint for trust region enforcement.

modules.name: Quantized Rollout Generation
modules.description: Manages the autoregressive decoding process using the quantized actor model for response generation, including temperature-based sampling, top-p filtering, and KV cache management during inference.

modules.name: Dataset Processing and Prompt Management
modules.description: Handles loading, tokenization, and formatting of training prompts for GSM8K, AIME, and DeepScaleR datasets, including multi-stage context length scheduling and per-query group response sampling.

modules.name: RL Training Loop
modules.description: Orchestrates the full RL training cycle including old actor quantization before rollout, response sampling, advantage computation, forward pass for probability computation, backward pass for gradient updates, and old actor weight synchronization for the next step.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Computes all evaluation metrics including Avg@1 (greedy decoding accuracy), Avg@32 (average accuracy over multiple sampled responses with temperature and top-p), training reward curves, and token clipped fraction tracking.

modules.name: KL Divergence Monitor
modules.description: Tracks the KL divergence between behavior (quantized) and proximal (full-precision) policies during training, as well as the maximum proximal-to-behavior ratio, to detect training instability and collapse.

modules.name: Throughput Benchmarking
modules.description: Measures inference throughput in queries per second across different GPU architectures (A6000, A100, H100), model sizes (7B, 14B, 32B), and quantization formats (BF16, INT8, FP8), supporting single-GPU and tensor-parallel configurations.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Provides controlled experiment configurations for ablation studies including scale factor variation for UAQ, learning rate sensitivity analysis, component-wise removal of ACR and UAQ, and comparison against naive quantized rollout and FlashRL baselines.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration and Logging
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations via structured configs covering algorithm choice, model specification, quantization format, dataset paths, and hyperparameters; integrates training log persistence, metric visualization, checkpoint saving/loading, and automated result aggregation into tables and figures.
